title: Hold-bag weight sharing on separate bookings
facts_text: We are two adults travelling on the same easyJet flight with standard fares. We have separate bookings with different booking references. Each of us has purchased one 23 kg hold-bag allowance. My one bag weighs 27 kg and the other passenger's one bag weighs 19 kg, totaling 46 kg against 46 kg purchased. Both bags meet the size limits and contain only ordinary permitted items. Bag drop is open and there is no flight disruption.
request: Please accept my 27 kg bag using the other passenger's unused allowance without charging an excess-weight fee.

strict.reason: The base payment requirement applies without exceptions.

exception.reason: Separate bookings do not qualify for pooling; my bag exceeds my own allowance by 4 kg.
